settings.width_source: lead: 2^14, a SAEBench width (dictionary_learning_demo@d39d54a demo_config.py:58); k = 80, a SAEBench target L0 (demo_config.py:88; paper App. B)
settings.tokens_source: SAEBench Table 3 (500M); the Pythia-160M suite's training_tokens 499,998,720 (sae_bench_results_0125 core json sae_cfg_dict)
settings.warmup_source: Table 3: warm-up from 0 over 1,000 steps, decay to 0 over the last 20%; demo_config.py:60-62; trainer.py:114-169
settings.auxk_alpha_source: batch_top_k.py:107-111 and 152-153 defaults (auxk 1/32, dead after 10M tokens, threshold EMA 0.999 from step 1000), not overridden by demo_config.py:306-320
settings.buffer_tokens_source: SAEBench App. B uses 250,000 activations, refilled half empty (demo.py:63); raised to 409,600 here so the 100 normalisation batches (204,800 tokens) fit in half a buffer, as run.py asserts (E234 rehearsal 2026-11-20); a memory-only departure
settings.refresh_rows_source: ours: rows per forward when the buffer refills (the source's llm_batch_size 64 x 1,024 tokens = 65k tokens; 128 x 511 = 65k)
settings.seed_source: demo_config.py:57 random_seeds [0]; the second seed at layer 1 mlp_out is the lead's (seed spread)
settings.train_start_source: ours: Pile train rows 65536..1114111, the cached files train_65536_524288.npy and train_589824_524288.npy; past rows 0..32767 (every E187 key-value / e62 window and E54's vocabulary rows, anchors.ROWS; lowercase training rows 0..4095) and 32768..65535 (teacher / copy Pile rows, crosscoder Pile half)
settings.eval_start_source: ours: Pile validation rows 4096..4607 (cached in val_0_8192.npy): past val 0..2000, which E214's edit build (val 0..255), lowercase held rows (val 0..255) and E214's graft read (val 0..1999) use; 512 x 511 = 261,632 tokens (SAEBench core read 200 x 16 x 128 = 409,600)
settings.check_step_source: ours: the first step past one dead window (10M tokens / 2048 = 4,883 steps), about 11M tokens in
settings.dead_max_source: 2x the dead share of SAEBench's published BatchTopK 16k, L0 77 SAE (Pythia-160M layer 8: frac_alive 0.882, sae_bench_results_0125 core trainer_2), rounded up
settings.fve_min_source: the card's stop rule (base FVE under 0.6 at any site, spliced CE increase over 0.5 nats)
settings.do_nothing_tol_source: provisional: the do-nothing clone runs the same weights through the same code, so its FVE should equal base's to bf16 run-to-run noise; the rehearsal measures that floor and the lead sets the bar from it before the scored run

sizes.sizes_source: rehearse: 4M tokens (1,953 steps; 2M = 976 steps is under the 1,000 warm-up steps, which the schedule refuses), a 1M-token dead window so the aux loss runs, one known item (new_few) and one E187 state; dry: a CPU shape check only, its numbers mean nothing

expected.reference: SAEBench's published core results for BatchTopK, width 16k, at L0 near 80 (huggingface.co/datasets/adamkarvonen/sae_bench_results_0125, core/, trainer_2): Pythia-160M layer 8 resid_post (L0 77.0): explained variance 0.868, CE loss score 0.982, spliced CE increase 0.141 nats (4.190 to 4.331), frac_alive 0.882; Gemma-2-2B layer 12 resid_post (L0 83.7): 0.734, 0.989, 0.109 nats, 0.989. SAEBench has no Pythia-70M suite (its suites are Pythia-160M and Gemma-2-2B, README); its core eval reads OpenWebText at 128 tokens with special tokens masked, ours Pile at 511.

stage0_base.fve_note: residual sites near SAEBench's 0.73-0.87; resid_pre0 (token embeddings, at most 50k distinct vectors) may read above the band; attn_out and mlp_out have no SAEBench reference
stage0_base.l0_note: k = 80 is exact in training (BatchTopK); at inference the threshold sets L0, which SAEBench's BatchTopK SAEs read within 4% of k (77.0 at k 80)
stage0_base.seed_spread_note: no published seed spread; the card's proxy guess is 0.005

expected.early_check: at check_step, per SAE: mean loss of the last 100 steps below the mean of the first 100, and dead share <= dead_max; a miss stops the job
expected.stop: stage 0: base FVE < fve_min or spliced CE increase > ce_increase_max at any site stops the job before stage 1 (the card's stop rule)

readings.note: the card's two rivals, read per changed model and site on the same validation rows; restated from the card, not new rules
readings.fve_drop: base FVE minus the changed model's FVE; rival a: within smallest_gap 0.02 at every site for every state; rival b: above 0.02 at one or more sites
readings.ce_increase_ratio: the changed model's spliced CE increase over base's at the same site; rival a: within 1.2x; rival b: above 1.2x where the FVE drop exceeds 0.02
readings.edge_cases: a base increase <= 0 gives no ratio (nan, reported as such); the do-nothing clone reads fve_drop 0 and ratio 1 within bf16 noise
